name: Moganshan Bamboo Villa
aiSummary: Review summary Powered by AI Culinary Experience:The on-site meals, particularly the home-cooked dishes by the host’s family, are praised for their delicious taste and authenticity. Local specialties like braised pork, garlic bones, and pickled vegetables are highlighted as must-try items.
address: No. 11, Fatou Fishing Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, 313206, China

comments.quote: I came here for a marathon event. Despite knowing no common language, the owners were extremely helpful and assisted me early morning with multiple taxis and in bad weather. Excellent and quick communication. I appreciate you!
